maria: Cutting RC image from main now — rc tag: rc-2026-03-19-1, sha: abc1234def. Pushing artifacts and pinning image: redwood/inference:rc-20260319. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full. Need +1 from @sam (SRE), @jen (QA), @ada (Product). :rocket:
deploy-bot: Build succeeded for commit abc1234def. Image pushed to registry: gcr.io/redwood/release/rc-20260319. Digest: sha256:deadbeef. CI: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/4789 :white_check_mark:
sam: autoscaling min=2 max=20, target CPU 60%. What's the rollback trigger?
maria: Rollback policy: automatic rollback to previous image if error rate >5% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency regresses >25%. Manual abort possible via the deploy UI. Command to rollback if needed:
```
# kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=previous
```
jen: smoke and integration suites finished on rc image — all green except one flaky rerun, see CI job. Load run shows p95 +3% vs baseline, fine to proceed :+1:
ada: quick q — any product flags or UI changes in this RC?
maria: infra-only; no product flags. All feature flags unchanged.
raj: Customer maintenance banner set for 02:00 UTC and status page pre-update queued. Notifying large customers via email.
ops-bot: Status page: scheduled maintenance created for 2026-03-19 02:00-06:00 UTC.
sam: I'll be watching infra metrics and autoscaler behavior during canary. +1 from SRE if canary gating is enforced by the rollout manager.
jen: +1 from QA — will run extra smoke checks at 5m and 30m marks.
ada: +1 from Product.
maria: Initiating canary promotion now. Kicking off 5% route. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary step started — routing 5% traffic to redwood/inference:rc-20260319. Monitoring hooks enabled (latency, errors, CPU, mem).
sam: seeing small spike in p95 at 3m, but within threshold. continuing watch. :mag:
jen: 5m smoke ok, all green. continuing to monitor external traces.
maria: advancing to 25% now per plan.
deploy-bot: Canary step complete — routing 25% traffic. Auto-rollback threshold active.
sam: p50 steady, error rate stable. No signs of cache pressure. Proceed.
raj: Ops note — rolling log rotation to avoid disk spike during longer runs.
maria: lifting to full now.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete — redwood/inference:rc-20260319 is now default image. :tada:
jen: post-deploy smoke passed. No regressions observed.
sam: SLOs within expected range, continuing to monitor for the next hour.
maria: thanks all — closing RC thread. Will open follow-up for postmortem if any regressions surface. :thumbsup:
